toolArgumentsForFutureRootApprovedGenera.prompt:
Create a brand-new TRUE RGBA transparent native sprite atlas for the CQC browser fighting game. Do not edit any existing generated atlas. The attached original game references guide silhouette and original palette, not invented fine detail.
Adult BLACK COLOR / BLACK NINJA, Kyle Schneider in the ORIGINAL 1990 MSX2 Metal Gear 2 incarnation. Match the small source sprite: pale grey/cyan head and lower-leg armor panels, dark teal/green upper flex-armor, black gaps, understated ochre hands and boot pixels. Enhanced human ninja wearing original flex armor. The fine tailoring and realistic face are unresolved; keep facial area minimally indicated without inventing a photographic face. No lavender generic armor. No katana, no sword sheath, no futuristic cyborg eye, no Gray Fox head optic, no original MG1 Schneider contact portrait. Throwing stars only as the limited source-supported projectile family, with exact hardware pattern unspecified.
Produce sheet C_RIGHT, exactly twelve COMPLETE separate full-body poses, ALL facing anatomically RIGHT. Author this orientation independently, never mirror a previous atlas. Every toe, sole, hand and held weapon must remain within its own cell with ample empty transparent margin. Maintain identical character scale and costume across all 12 poses. Native landscape atlas with FOUR columns and THREE rows, read left to right then top to bottom. No text, cell borders, labels, grey matte, checkerboard image background, shadow floor, stage, watermark, detached effects, spare heads or extra mini bodies. Leave clear separation between all 12 connected actor silhouettes. Any held equipment must stay connected to the hands/body. Do not paint projectiles, explosions, flying stars, detached tripwires or muzzle flashes. Full opacity for actual cloth/body/gear; true alpha 0 outside actor. These are native source images and must never be cleaned, scaled or pixel-edited after generation.
Four triplets, numbered 0–11 in this exact order: 0,1,2=starThrow: Hand throwing-star preparation / hand extension to release / balanced recovery; held small star attached to fingers only at preparation, no detached flying projectile; 3,4,5=cqcThrow: Unarmed close grapple preparation / adapted throw follow-through / recovery, no sword; 6,7,8=evade: Bounded quick-step preparation / low movement / planted recovery, no invisibility effect; 9,10,11=recover: Unarmed reserve recovery stance / measured breath / upright return.
Render a crisp polished 2D sprite style grounded in the tiny original 1990 silhouette/palette. Do not claim invented anatomical detail, textures, balance actions or hardware is official 1:1. Aim for the nearest supported reconstruction, retain unknown details unobtrusively, and keep every complete pose suitable for independent native source cropping and foot-pivot measurement.
